headline: Danish parliament elects a speaker criticised over a 2019 land sale
lede: The Folketing, Denmark's parliament, elected Henrik Frandsen of the Moderates, a liberal party founded by Lars Løkke Rasmussen, a former prime minister, as its speaker on Tuesday despite criticism over a 2019 land sale.

definitions.definition: a liberal party founded by Lars Løkke Rasmussen, a former prime minister
